Game Overview

At its heart, Hill Monkey is a driving game about race to the top in Hill Monkey, where quick reflexes and strategic jumps propel you past global rivals. Choose from three dynamic modes and conquer steep challenges in this pulse-pounding hill climbing adventure. Whether casual or competitive, it's an adrenaline-fueled test of speed and agility.
